window.title: Andrew Pang
window.summary: I'm a Senior Software Engineer passionate about building software that solves real-world problems. From fintech platforms serving millions of users to AI-powered developer tooling, I enjoy taking products from idea to production with strong focus on good user experience.
bullets: React Native and cross-platform mobile application development
Full-stack development with TypeScript, Node.js and AWS
AI-assisted coding, agentic workflows and developer tooling
Scalable design systems and frontend performance
Technical leadership, mentoring and cross-functional collaboration

window.title: Crypto.com
window.summary: Crypto.com is a cryptocurrency exchange company that offers various financial services, including an app, exchange, and noncustodial DeFi wallet, NFT marketplace, and direct payment service in cryptocurrency. It consistently ranks amongst the 10 cryptocurrency exchanges globally
bullets: Selected as an early member of the React Native foundation team.
Led development of the design system powering the app-wide UI/UX overhaul.
Leveraged multi-agent AI workflows and spec-driven engineering to rapidly deliver production-ready components.
Developed all of the end-to-end Maestro test suite to prevent UI regressions.
Built AI agent skills and design system test harnesses, driving rapid company-wide adoption of design system components.
Integrated Claude Code with Figma MCP servers, enabling designers to code.
Collaborated closely with stakeholders to own components from specs to prod.

window.title: MoneyLion
window.summary: MoneyLion is an industry leader in fintech, powering the next generation of personalized financial products and content, with a top consumer finance super app, a premier embedded finance platform for enterprise businesses and a world-class media arm. It ranks amongst the top 10 financial apps in the Apple App Store and Google Play Store in the US.
bullets: Joined as a graduate engineer replacing two mid-level engineers
Promoted to mid-level engineer after one year based on delivery impact.
Led and mentored junior engineers developing investing products.
Launched a financial membership that instantly drove massive growth in subscriptions and monthly recurring revenue.
Leveraged AI-assisted workflows to redesign investing experiences.
Indentified wastage and optimised code to reduce monthly infrastructure cost
Brainstormed product ideas that increased onboarding onto investing products.

window.title: Monash University PRIME Program
window.summary: Full Stack Engineer leading the development of an AI-assisted healthcare intervention platform.
bullets: Led a team of 6 building a pre-diabetes detection and intervention application.
Developed predictive machine learning models identifying 100+ pre-diabetic users.
Enabled pharmacist-led intervention through data-driven patient insights.
Awarded Gold at the 33rd International Invention, Innovation & Technology Exhibition (ITEX) 2022.

window.title: Setel
window.summary: Introduced in July 2018, Setel is first mobile app in Malaysia that is designed to ease motorists’ journey across fuelling, parking, EV charging, motor insurance, road tax, auto assistance, general purchases and more across an ecosystem of PETRONAS petrol stations, retail partners, and online merchants.
bullets: Collaborated with developers to launch a point-of-sales system deployed in 1600+ fuel stations in Malaysia.
Enhanced UI/UX for a station operator monitoring tool, reducing time and complexity to perform crucial tasks.
